scope: Metadata-only intake mapping. No intensities, model predictions, or final sample selection used. Parent runner must enforce session dates and preregistered split.
normalization: strip whitespace, lowercase, remove ASCII non-alphanumeric characters; no fuzzy matching; union Target/Spectrum Name/Sample Name; require exactly one row.
canonical_physical_id_policy: Normalized published Spectrum Name when nonblank, otherwise normalized Target. Aliases do not prove independent parent material; exclusions/family warnings are separately recorded.
